npcs.greeting: The same hands made every version of your set. Leave the piece with me and take the one that suits how you fight now. No charge. Keepers do not sell.

npcs.name: Thane Morgrim Onyxhand
npcs.greeting:
You came down through the Dry Deep. We don't get many who do.

I'm Morgrim. I run the working, which means the mine, the forges and the gate. Trade's welcome and the shops are on the Row behind you. If you're looking for work as well, talk to Captain Yrsa at the gate. She always has more trouble than guards.

npcs.name: Forgemaster Garrun Slagborn
npcs.greeting:
I teach mining and smithing, and I teach them together. I've no use for a smith who can't tell good ore from bad.

Show me what you already know and we'll start from there.

npcs.name: Gate-Captain Yrsa Stonebar
npcs.greeting:
The Thane says the gate opens for trade, so it opens for you. I'd still like to know your business before you go back out.

There are three things to watch for out there. The hive's to the south-east. The mushroom wood is south-west, and it's worse than it looks. North-east are the old diggings, and the people in them used to live here. Don't expect a welcome.

npcs.name: Gate-Guard Dunmar
npcs.greeting: Knock the sand off your boots before you go up the Row, would you? Hulda found grit in her quench last week and we all heard about it.

npcs.name: Gate-Guard Oda
npcs.greeting: Six years I've stood on this gate. I've seen the hive come right up to the towers twice. Both times they turned round at the braziers, so we keep the braziers lit.

npcs.name: Sentry Rurik Boltwright
npcs.greeting:
Quiet a moment.

...No. Thought I heard digging. The hive tunnels under the wall sometimes, so I spend most of my watch with an ear to the rock. You get so you can tell them from our own miners.

npcs.name: Vault-Keeper Aldis Greylock
npcs.greeting:
Every bar poured in Onyxhollow gets weighed and written down here. I have the books going back to the first shaft.

Some of the names in the early ones belong to people who were put out of the gate. The Thane wanted them struck from the record. I told him the weights were still true, and he let it go.

npcs.name: Ashkeeper Torvald
npcs.greeting:
This fire was lit from the first furnace we built, and it hasn't gone out since. Keeping it fed is my whole job.

You're welcome to warm your hands. Half the town does on their way to shift.

npcs.name: Stoker Hald Cinderlung
npcs.greeting:
The furnace takes a cart of coal a shift, and I'm the one who shovels it.

Garrun says the heat is where the craft is. He's probably right, but I notice he says it from the other side of the yard.

npcs.name: Loremaster Ingrid Pagewright
npcs.greeting:
Have you seen the walls out on the Strand? There are tide marks on them, high up. That was a sea once, with a shoreline, and somebody must have lived on it.

I'd like to find out who. The Thane thinks it's a waste of lamp oil, so I mostly ask travellers. If you come across anything out there that looks made rather than grown, I'd be glad to hear about it.

npcs.name: Geomancer Vigdis Stonesong
npcs.greeting:
You walked through the caves above us to get here, the dry ones with the holes up to the desert. That's our roof, and it's a lot thinner than people here like to think about.

I listen to it for the Thane. It's holding, for now. I'd be happier if things stopped eating the pillars.

npcs.name: Lookout Hervi Longstair
npcs.greeting:
You made it down. Sit a minute if you need to, it's a long stair.

I'm posted here to see who comes down and send them on to the gate. Follow the slag road south-east and keep to it. You'll see the braziers. Onyxhollow's at the end, between the two towers.

npcs.name: Noor Haddad
npcs.greeting:
Oh, hello. Sorry, I don't get many people coming past.

I'm a geologist. I was one before all this, in Amman, and it turns out the job still exists if you don't mind who you work for. The surveyors up at Fourth Peg told me about the caves and I kept going down. I've been camped here about a month. The dwarves think I'm odd but they sell me bread.

npcs.name: Brannoc
npcs.greeting:
I'm allowed as far as this brazier. Yrsa lets me sit here as long as I don't go near the gate.

I lived in there for forty years. I was put out with the rest of my shift and I've been in the old diggings since. If you're going into town, don't tell them you spoke to me. It won't help you.

npcs.name: Wind-Rider Tazzi Updraft
npcs.greeting:
Need a lift out? It's a long climb otherwise.

I fly from the platform. The birds like it down here, there's water and it's out of the wind. Getting them to leave again is the hard part. I can take you to Steamwheedle Port or anywhere beyond it you've already been.

npcs.name: Dr. Imani Mwangi
npcs.greeting:
If you're hurt, sit down on the crate and I'll have a look.

I ran the clinic on the Likoni ferry in Mombasa for eleven years. Three years ago the ferry docked at a pier that hadn't been there that morning, and I've been treating dwarves and goblins ever since. Most of what I see here is burns.

npcs.name: Shipwright Rozz Keelhaul
npcs.greeting:
I build the barges that carry ore round the island.

They gave me this beach, a saw pit and a crew of four. I've launched six hulls since spring and I've only got two left. Something out in the shallows keeps sinking them.

npcs.name: Teodora Vasquez
npcs.greeting:
Please watch where you step. Half of what's growing here hasn't been named yet.

I taught botany at the university in Quito before I came through. The Ashclaim pays me to tell them which plants on this island are worth money. Nothing here is in any of my books.

npcs.name: Foreman Brakka Sootmantle
npcs.greeting:
This is the Ashclaim Works. The smelter behind me is the only thing on the island making money right now.

I've got sixty people working here. The ground shakes twice a day and the Cinder Flats are full of fire elementals, so keeping all sixty of them alive takes most of my time.

npcs.name: Enginewright Tobble Vantz
npcs.greeting:
I keep the pump engine and the winding gear at the mine head running.

The air off the vents eats brass in a month and iron in a season, so I spend most of my time rebuilding things I've already built.

npcs.name: Doorwarden Kettil Grimstead
npcs.greeting:
That opening goes down into the Emberdeep. I'm here to tell people what's down there before they go in.

There's a lake of molten rock with islands of cooled stone in it, and everything living down there came out of the lake. The Thane's people sealed this door a long time ago. It broke open three years ago.

npcs.name: Coast-Surveyor Mizzi Dredgeline
npcs.greeting:
I'm charting this coast for a harbour, and I've lost two boats doing it.

The wrecks along this shore are older than the Ashclaim. Somebody was sailing here long before the goblins came, and the naga have moved into what's left of their ships.

npcs.name: Scout Varga Cinderstep
npcs.greeting:
Stay on the dark ground out here. The pale crust is thin and there's steam under it.

I walk the Cinder Flats for the Foreman and mark where the vents have moved, so the ore carts know which way is safe. They move most weeks.

npcs.name: Assayer Ruddi Halfweight
npcs.greeting:
I weigh and test every load of ore that comes out of the mine.

The dwarves get paid by what I weigh, so a lot of them think I'm cheating them. I'm not, and I'm the reason the goblins aren't either.

npcs.name: Blaster Orrin Slowmatch
npcs.greeting:
I set the blasting charges at the mine head. Please don't smoke near the red shed.

Blasting inside a volcano takes a lot of care. The last blaster here lost both his hands.

npcs.name: Dr. Kenji Arakawa
npcs.greeting:
I watch the volcano for the Ashclaim and tell them when it's dangerous.

I worked at the observatory in Kagoshima for twenty years, watching Sakurajima. Three years ago I walked out of the building and the bay was gone. This mountain doesn't behave like any volcano I've studied.

npcs.name: Harbourmaster Skezz Mooringline
npcs.greeting:
I run the berths. Every boat that ties up here pays a fee.

I've lost four barges between here and the landing this season, and the Underwriter wants to know why. So do I.

npcs.name: Deedkeeper Thora Runebrand
npcs.greeting:
I keep the rolls of Khaz Varun, the records of every birth, oath and debt from before the city went dark.

The Thane's claim depends on these rolls, so I keep the key on a cord round my neck.

npcs.name: Adjuster Priya Raman
npcs.greeting:
I assess losses for the Underwriter. When a barge sinks, I work out whether it was bad luck or bad seamanship.

I did the same job for a marine insurer in Singapore. Three years ago I was inspecting a container ship when the harbour changed around it. The goblins understand insurance better than anyone I worked with there.

npcs.name: Battlemaster Ingra Coalbeard
npcs.greeting:
I train fighters of every kind, and I don't much care which kind you are.

The Thane brought me over to teach his own people before they went into the hall. Most of them have gone in now, so I've got time for anyone who can pay. Show me what you can do and I'll show you what comes next.

npcs.name: Forgemaster Ulfa Hammerdeep
npcs.greeting:
If you want to mine Khaz Varun's iron or work it, I can teach you both.

The ore on this island is better than anything on the mainland, and dark iron's the best of it. It's also the fussiest metal you'll ever put in a fire, so learn it from someone who's ruined plenty of it.

npcs.name: Herbalist Zinnia Sporewick
npcs.greeting:
I can teach you which plants on this island are worth picking and what to do with them once you've got them.

The Green Belt's full of things the mainland's never seen. Half of them will heal you and the other half will put you in Dr. Mwangi's tent, so it's worth paying someone to tell you which half is which.

npcs.name: Tanner Brog Ashpelt
npcs.greeting:
I work hides, leather and cloth, and I cook, because nobody else on this wharf will do it properly. I'll teach you to fish for the pot as well.

A basilisk hide off the Cinder Flats makes the best leather I've ever handled. I'll teach you to skin it, cure it and stitch it, and I'll teach you what to do with the meat while you're at it.

npcs.name: Woodwright Kibble Sawtooth
npcs.greeting:
I can teach you to cut timber and work it, and on this island that mostly means bloodwood and felbark.

The jungle wood's too green for hulls, so I use it for everything else. If you want to know which trees are worth felling, I've felled most of the wrong ones already.

npcs.name: Tinker Fezzik Coilspring
npcs.greeting:
I teach engineering, and I'll tell you now that the vents on this island will try to eat everything you build.

I keep the town's pumps running when Tobble at the Works can spare me a gasket. If you want to learn how to build something that lasts out here, I'm the one to ask.

npcs.name: Artifact Keeper Hilde Ironveil
npcs.greeting:
I can change a set piece you're wearing into the version that suits the way you fight now, and I don't charge for it.

If you've brought a token up from the old city or out of the Emberdeep, I'll turn that into a piece for you as well. The Keepers sent me here because this is where the tokens are being found.
